title: 第一卷 第25章 收刮第一卷 第26章 听小叔的话不
content_zh:
“能耐分假能耐和真能耐，你现在连站起来说话都站不了，看来只是假能耐了。”
“哗啦~”
山脉拐角处，李乘风摇着脑袋一边开口，一边弯腰将三具尸体身上的东西一一解下，将其中钱袋里面的银两铜钱倒出来。
“杀人放火金腰带，古人诚不欺我。”
看着约莫是五两一锭的一个大银锭，约莫三两银子一锭的小银锭两个，和约摸一两的六个小银块，以及一些散碎银子，数十枚铜钱，出声感慨。
这么多银两，要搁穿越前身打短工来算，在重重剥削下，一辈子都不一定能攒下来。
可是现在，几箭的功夫，就被他弄到了手。
“暴力，永远是最有效直接的方式啊。”
李乘风颇为感慨地将银两用刘勇的大钱袋收起来，揣在自己腰上，拍了拍鼓鼓囊囊的腰包，又看了看旁边的三把钢刀、三支长弓、三篓长箭、三把匕首。
“这刘勇应该不只是一个小小长工那么简单，肯定还有着其他牵扯，否则不至于有那么多的银子，还能叫这么多人来给他卖命办事。”
李乘风瞅着这三人的尸体，一边想一边满意地将东西都装进了袋子里。
“这三人配置还都挺齐整，恐怕是常年一起办事，现在死也死在一起，恐怕你们也知足了。”
李乘风收拾好了东西，往背上一背，回头看了看草丛里倒在地上的三个睁着眼睛的尸体，脸上一笑，“希望你们黄泉路上也这么友好。”
话毕，李乘风管都没管刘勇三人的尸体，直接返程而去。
他们三个的尸体在山林里，大自然都消化了，不用他多操心。
反倒是钱的事，得操点心。
虽然把刘勇他们身上带的钱拿走了，但是他们家里的钱可还没拿呢。
人死了，他们的钱就是他的了。
他怎么能把自己的钱放在别人家里呢？
这不合适。

至于进山打猎的事？
背上背的，这不都是打猎收获吗？
没人规定打猎不能捕到现成的银两和刀弓啊。
“这三把弓可以留一把备用，剩下的看看能不能交易给山里的其他猎户，钢刀和匕首留在家里也无妨。”
李乘风背着满满的狩猎收获往回赶，心中愉悦的随意思索。
刘勇他们三个用的弓、刀和匕首都是非常制式的东西，他已经检查了一番，和刘宏的不同，都没有丝毫个人痕迹，所以可以安心地留着自己用。
李乘风对从刘勇他们身上得到的东西都很满意！
不过他弓已经有了两把，刘勇三人的弓虽然加了更多材料，比他的弓也不逊色，但再留一把备用就好，剩下的两把倒是可以交易出去，换些能用的东西回来。
“也不知道他们家里藏着多少银子。”
李乘风心里回忆着刘勇家的位置，心里期待，大踏步地走出了山林。
刘勇曾经哄骗着他卖嫂子，肯定要和原身有所交集，李乘风记忆里自然有这刘勇家的位置。
甚至他也知道刘勇家里没女人，只在外面养的有情人，所以，哪怕是白天他也能进去搜刮东西。
刘勇家是肯定能搜点东西回来的。
李乘风提着精神穿过私人山林前的乡道，一路回到了城中，连家也没回，径直到了刘勇家门外。
和李乘风家只用篱笆堵的院子不同，刘勇家里的院子是用土坯加砖砌的，院门也更大有威慑力。
或许是因为刘勇平时不好惹，他家周围一个人也没有。
content_en:
"Ability can be divided into fake ability and real ability. You can't even stand up and talk now. It seems you are just a fake ability."
"Wow~"
At the corner of the mountain range, Li Chengfeng shook his head and spoke, while bending down to untie the things from the three corpses one by one, and poured out the silver and two copper coins in the wallet.
"The golden belt of murder and arson, the ancients will not deceive me."
Looking at a large silver ingot of about five taels per ingot, two small silver ingots of about three taels of silver per ingot, six small silver nuggets of about one tael, as well as some scattered silver and dozens of copper coins, I sighed with emotion.
Such a large amount of money would not necessarily be able to be saved in a lifetime due to heavy exploitation, even if one had to work part-time in the previous life.
But now, with just a few arrows, he got it.
"Violence is always the most effective and direct way."
Li Chengfeng put away the money in Liu Yong's big purse with emotion, put it on his waist, patted the bulging pocket, and looked at the three steel knives, three long bows, three baskets of long arrows, and three daggers next to him.
"This Liu Yong should be more than just a small long-term worker. He must have other involvements. Otherwise, he wouldn't have so much money and so many people to work for him."
Li Chengfeng looked at the bodies of the three people and put everything into the bag with satisfaction while thinking.
"These three people are quite well-organized. I'm afraid they work together all year round. Now they will die together. I'm afraid you are content."
Li Chengfeng packed up his things, carried them on his back, looked back at the three open-eyed corpses lying on the ground in the grass, and said with a smile, "I hope you will be so friendly on the road to Huangquan."
After speaking, Li Chengfeng didn't care about the bodies of Liu Yong and the others and returned directly.
The bodies of the three of them were in the mountains and forests, and had been digested by nature, so he didn't need to worry too much.
On the contrary, it is a matter of money, so you have to worry about it.
Although the money carried by Liu Yong and others was taken away, the money from their home was not taken away.
When a person dies, their money is theirs.
How could he leave his money in someone else's house?
This is inappropriate.
As for hunting in the mountains?
What's on your back, isn't this all the harvest of hunting?
No one stipulates that you cannot catch ready-made silver coins, swords and bows when hunting.
"You can keep one of these three bows as a spare, and see if the rest can be traded to other hunters in the mountains. It doesn't hurt to keep the steel knives and daggers at home."
Li Chengfeng hurried back with a full harvest of hunting on his back, thinking happily in his heart.
The bows, knives and daggers used by Liu Yong and the others were all very standard. He had already checked them, and found that they were different from Liu Hong's and had no personal traces on them, so he could safely keep them for his own use.
Li Chengfeng was very satisfied with what he got from Liu Yong and the others!
However, he already has two bows. Although the bows of Liu Yong and the others are not inferior to his bows with more materials added, it is good to keep one as a spare. The remaining two can be traded out and brought back with something useful.
"I don't know how much money they have hidden in their home."
Li Chengfeng recalled the location of Liu Yong's family in his heart, and strode out of the forest with anticipation.
Liu Yong once coaxed him into selling his sister-in-law, so he must have some interaction with the original person. Liu Yong's family naturally has a place in Li Chengfeng's memory.
He even knew that Liu Yong didn't have a woman in his family, he only had lovers outside, so he could go in and search for things even during the day.
Liu Yong's family will definitely be able to find something.
Li Chengfeng walked energetically through the rural road in front of the private forest and returned to the city. He didn't even return home and went straight to the door of Liu Yong's house.
Unlike Li Chengfeng's yard, which is only blocked by fences, Liu Yong's yard is made of adobe and bricks, and the gate is larger and more intimidating.
Maybe it's because Liu Yong is usually not easy to mess with, and there is no one around his house.
